caption: The drawing features a single object, a jug or pitcher, positioned in the upper central part of the composition. The jug is rendered with a thin, black outline and has a rounded body with a relatively narrow neck and a small handle attached near the top. The remainder of the canvas is blank, with a light beige or cream background that is consistent across the entire image. Near the shoulder of the jug, there is a small area of decoration consisting of blue brushstrokes that resemble a feather or a leaf-like shape, placed to the left of the handle and just below the jug's rim. The composition is otherwise unembellished, with the jug being the sole object depicted.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
